shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- spec ---'; sed -n '1,240p' specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md; printf '%s\\n' '--- dod ---'; if [ -f .lore/dod.md ]; then sed -n '1,240p' .lore/dod.md; fi; printf '%s\\n' '--- files ---'; rg --files | sed -n '1,160p'; printf '%s\\n' '--- package ---'; sed -n '1,220p' package.json"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,240p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts; printf '%s\\n' '--- tests setup/relevant ---'; sed -n '1,180p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts; sed -n '180,300p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts; printf '%s\\n' '--- config types/factory ---'; sed -n '1,220p' src/config.ts; sed -n '1,180p' src/orchestration/index.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- test commands ---'; sed -n '1,240p' .lore/test-commands.yml; printf '%s\\n' '--- acceptance examples ---'; rg --files -g '*.acceptance.test.*' | head -30; printf '%s\\n' '--- remaining onError tests ---'; sed -n '300,390p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts; printf '%s\\n' '--- git ---'; git status --short --branch; git log -5 --oneline"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "nl -ba src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts | sed -n '1,90p'; printf '%s\\n' '--- diff ---'; git diff --check; git diff --stat; git diff -- .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git status --short --branch; git add .lore/dod.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && git commit -m "Define non-Error rejection acceptance test" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git status --short --branch; git log -1 --oneline --decorate; git rev-list --left-right --count HEAD...@{upstream}'
